name: Delegate To Codex Cli
summary: Delegate a bounded task to Codex CLI in an isolated, reviewable workspace.
description: Delegate an independent coding or review task to Codex CLI with a narrow brief, isolated worktree, bounded permissions, and parent-agent verification. Use only when the CLI is available and parallel delegation adds value.
refuses: It does not grant broader filesystem, network, or credential access than the parent task.
It does not let the delegate commit, push, deploy, or contact people unless explicitly authorized.
It does not accept a delegate claim as proof without parent-side review.
